ITEM 1 | Two long, thin strips of cooked meat with reddish-brown to dark amber coloring, darker edges and lighter translucent centers, crisp-looking with ruffled, wavy edges and some rendered fat sheen, lying side by side on a white plate; the longer strip is about 13 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, curled with a folded end, the shorter strip about 8 cm long and 1 cm wide, both roughly 0.3 cm thick and holding their shape | 28

ITEM 2 | Small crumb-like fleck of golden-tan, slightly crumbly material near the top edge of the plate, about 0.8 cm across, dry surface | 1

ITEM 3 | Thin orange-yellow greasy smear and faint residue spots scattered on the plate surface around the strips, no defined pile, slight sheen | 2
